name: JG_FSCL_DOC_RELATIONS_ALL
description: This table stores one or more fiscal documents details that are generated for one transaction in Fusion e.g. in drop ship case, two fiscal documents are generated corresponding to one shipment by the party shipping the goods.

columns.name: DOC_RELATION_ID
columns.description: Document relation identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_KEY
columns.description:
Indicates the fiscal document access key composed by adding the fiscal document number and other fiscal document information for Goods and Regular Service Fiscal Documents.
For National Service Fiscal Documents, this column stores the provisional service document key by adding the provisional service document number and other fiscal document information. It is used as unique identifier for the tax authority system.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_TYPE
columns.description: Fiscal document type of the transaction. Possible values are Remittance Fiscal Document, Symbolic Remittance Fiscal Document, and Sale Fiscal Document.

columns.name: DOC_HDR_ID
columns.description: Document header identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction, such as requisition, purchase order and agreement, and release.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: System-generated identification number of a transaction.

columns.name: DOC_NUM
columns.description: Unique number that is assigned to a document, such as fiscal document number or tax invoice number.

columns.name: SERIES
columns.description: Tax document series, to be filled with zero when there is no series.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_DATE
columns.description: The date the transaction occurred.

columns.name: MODEL
columns.description: Model for the fiscal document associated with the transaction. For example, 1, 1A, 55.

columns.name: DELIVERY_NOTE_PRINTING_FORMAT
columns.description: Delivery note printing format with valid values such as 1 for portrait or 2 for landscape.

columns.name: DOC_ISSUE_TYPE
columns.description: Fiscal document issue type with valid values such as 1 standard or 2 contingency.

columns.name: DOC_NATURE
columns.description: Fiscal document nature. Possible values are 1 for standard, 2 for complementary, and 3 for adjustment.

columns.name: DOC_GEN_PROCESS
columns.description: Fiscal document generation process. Possible values are 0 for issuance with taxpayer application, 1 for single issuance by the Revenue Bureau, 2 for single issuance by the taxpayer with digital certificate through the Revenue Bureaus website.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_DATE
columns.description: Date and hour of entry in contingency with format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_JUSTIFICATION
columns.description: Justification for entry in contingency.

columns.name: VOID_DATE
columns.description: Date when transaction is cancelled or marked as void.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Fiscal document status associated with the transaction, such as in process, sent, finalized, error, denied or void.

columns.name: REJECTION_REASON
columns.description: Reason provided by tax authority when fiscal document status is "Denied". Possible values include "Error access key - field identifier does not match the concatenation of the corresponding fields" or "The version of the layout used and is no longer valid".

columns.name: REF_DOC_HDR_ID
columns.description: Reference document header identifier.

columns.name: REF_DOC_NUM
columns.description: Reference document number of the tranaction.

columns.name: REF_FISCAL_DOC_KEY
columns.description: Key identifier for a reference fiscal document.

columns.name: REF_FISCAL_DOC_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the reference transaction occurred.

columns.name: REF_MODEL
columns.description: Model for the fiscal document associated with the reference transaction.

columns.name: REF_SERIES
columns.description: Tax document series of the reference document.

columns.name: REF_ISSUER_TAXPAYER_ID
columns.description: Tax registration identifier for the reference document taxpayer.

columns.name: REF_RURAL_FLAG
columns.description: Checkbox that Identifies whether the reference document was issued in rural area.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RPS_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of provisional receipt for services sent to the city tax authority.

columns.name: SRVC_INVOICE_VERIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Verification code of the fiscal document for a service invoice.

columns.name: VOID_REASON
columns.description: Reason provided by the user for setting the transaction status as void.

columns.name: CANCEL_REASON
columns.description: Reason provided by the user for setting the transaction status as cancelled.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_TYPE
columns.description: Fiscal document contingency type with valid values, such as Security form, Contingency system of national environment, and Declaration of issuance provided in the contingency.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID
columns.description: Document line identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: PROCESSED_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Date and time when a fiscal document was processed by the tax authority.

columns.name: PROTOCOL_NUMBER
columns.description: Number generated by the tax authority to uniquely identify the transactions of authorization, cancelation, and void related to a fiscal document.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_NUMBER_FLAG
columns.description: For multiple fiscal documents against a single transaction, track the fiscal document that is used as a tax invoice number in Oracle Fusion Receivables. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_SERIES
columns.description: Fiscal document series for contingency fiscal documents.

columns.name: SENDING_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the file used to request approval from tax authority during fiscal document generation process.

columns.name: RECEIVED_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the file received from tax authority during fiscal document generation process.

columns.name: REF_DOC_ISSUER_STATE_CODE
columns.description: State code for the reference document issuer.

columns.name: TAX_AUTH_DOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Certificate number provided by the muncipality on payment of taxes.

columns.name: TAX_SETTLEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of certificate provided by the muncipality on payment of taxes.

columns.name: LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the first party associated with the transaction.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_FISCAL_DOC_KEY1
columns.description: This will be used to store the fiscal_doc_key that is getting updated to TEMPID-ERROR in case of status error during first iteration

columns.name: PREVIOUS_FISCAL_DOC_KEY2
columns.description: This will be used to store the fiscal_doc_key that is getting updated to TEMPID-ERROR in case of status error during second iteration

columns.name: NATIONAL_SERVICE_FSCL_DOC_KEY
columns.description: Indicates the National Service Fiscal Document Key

columns.name: CANCEL_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the Cancel Reason code you provided when setting the transaction status as cancelled

columns.name: TAX_AUTHORITY_DOC_NUMBER
columns.description: The unique identifier of the transaction provided by the tax authority to identify transactions in the Brazil VAT centralized system.
